description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView that implements the LogNode interface to output log data received from various parts of an Android application. It formats log messages with priority, tag, message, and exception details, and supports chaining with other LogNode instances.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView for displaying log data, implementing LogNode to format and output log messages within an Android UI.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log data with priority, tag, message, and throwable information, then appends it to the TextView, and forwards it to the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append strings to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView.
